name: Usurp the Shadow Throne / no usurp full13cost and actual13attack fully blocked
printed_text:
**Viserai Specialization**

If you've usurped this turn, this costs 6{r} less to play and you may play it from your banished zone.

When this hits a hero, turn all cards in their banished zone face-down. They lose X{h} and you gain X{h}, where X is the number of cards turned face-down this way.

**Blood Debt**
format_scope: Four genuine manual legal young natural20 Heroes. Shadow Runeblade Viserai Between Worlds satisfies talent/class and Viserai specialization, not Usurper form; no usurp/private effect is seeded. Isolated lawful midturn Hand6/Hand5 and one prior opposing face-up Generic Banish; no deck copy limit exceeded. Actual four distinct Blue3 plusRed1 pays printed13 from Hand without discount, only then AP spent. Actual13attack fully blocked by distinct legal Generic cards3+3+3+3+2=14. Therefore no on-hit banish conversion/life loss/gain is earned despite a nonempty opposing Banish. This validates the unearned discount/full-cost branch and combat, not positive usurp or hit abilities.
